newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. secretary of state says it is important for Iran to support Middle East peace process.
- The Newly-elected Iranian president renews allegiance to the late Ayatollah Khomeini.
- Local banks operating in the United Arab Emirates posted $666 million profits in 1996.
- Qatar opens an official stock exchange, 17 firms are registered with shares worth six billion riyals.
- Taleban's government wins Saudi Arabian recognition.
- Egyptian holding company sells land and real estate worth 1.3 billion pounds.
- Tunisian exports in the first four months of 1997 were worth $1.9 million.
